configurations.//: MUST be dev-server.py, never `python3 -m http.server`. The stock
configurations.//2: server answers with Last-Modified and no Cache-Control, so the
configurations.//3: browser heuristically caches every ES module: you edit a file,
configurations.//4: reload, and are shown the PREVIOUS build with nothing in the
configurations.//5: console. This entry WAS the stock server, and it silently cost a
configurations.//6: debugging session — the fix looked like it had not worked.
configurations.name: primos-run

configurations.//: Same server, second port — for when another session (often one in
configurations.//2: a .claude/worktrees/ checkout) already owns 4177. A worktree's
configurations.//3: server on 4177 serves THAT tree's files: an edit made here keeps
configurations.//4: 'not working' because the page is running a different checkout.
configurations.//5: Verify who owns a port before debugging: lsof -nP -iTCP:4177
configurations.name: primos-run-alt
